summary: Accepted ZS1-180/181/182/184 by running their registered validators and adding missing proof tests. Fixed one real ZS1-180 defect: `zenpi --auto` set the root owner's mode to Never but never recorded the explicit auto choice (regression from 6d22c34), so ProjectOwnerPool.auto_approve() was false and the arch owner / newly prepared project owners fell back to ReadOnly. New Agent::enable_auto_approve() (keeps per-tool rules, sets Never + auto flag) is called on the --auto path. Also added Agent::max_tool_iterations() getter and fixed a misplaced doc comment on set_max_tool_iterations.

notes: Open gap outside owned paths (not fixed): ZS1-182 says headless/JSONL approval responses also carry the reject message, but src/headless.rs (stdio approve at ~5812/6528 and respond_to_slash_approval ~7386) hardcodes `message: None` and SlashCommand::Approve (src/slash.rs) has no message field, so a headless deny cannot pass feedback to the model. Needs a follow-up item owning src/headless.rs + src/slash.rs. The /yolo TUI toggle only updates TuiState.auto_approve, not the pool flag; project switches honour it via state, but newly prepared arch owners follow pool.auto_approve() - noted, not changed. No new non-test unwrap/expect/panic, unsafe, or Arc<Mutex> in src.
